name: 无限刃·二段

(killTag.intensity || 0) : 0; var multiplier = kills >= 2 ? 2 : (kills >= 1 ? 1.5 : 1); var damage = Math.floor(source.attack * multiplier); var result = dealDamage(source, currentTarget, damage, 'true', battle, 'shishio-infinite-blade'); return { success: true, message: source.name + '失去' + (selfResult.damage !== undefined ? selfResult.damage : 0) + '点生命，再次发动无限刃，对' + currentTarget.name + '造成' + (result.damage !== undefined ? result.damage : damage) + '点真实伤害' };
